receipts.first_text_witness: You're not poor because you don't make enough money. You're poor because the system is designed to keep you that way. And the worst part is you probably don't even see it happening. Most people walk around thinking they're making rational financial decisions when they're actually trapped in an invisible prison that's been carefully constructed around them since childhood. The bars aren't made of steel. They're made of payments, subscriptions, lifestyle expectations, and the constant whisper that you deserve things you can't actually afford. My name is Nick, and I've spent years studying how money actually works versus how we're told it works. And the gap between those two things is where most people lose their entire lives.
